body:
"Friends System" Mod
This mod adds a friends system to your client.

Features
Friend's name in the tab list is highlighted with a green [Friend] tag
Friends are displayed with their own unique cape
Friends list is saved between sessions
Commands
.friend help — list of all available commands
.friend add <nickname> — add a player to your friends list
.friend remove <nickname> — remove a player from your friends list
.friend list — show the current friends list
